title: The Certain look in his eye
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：certain　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 certain 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the shopkeeper wrote of ① a certain look in his eye in the account, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② more certain than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the shopkeeper, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the certain ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most certain look in his eye anybody in the shop had ever seen, or so the account for July 1980 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too certain to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the certain ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a certain reason for leaving, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as certain as the reason for leaving they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was certain or not, and he said so.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was ⑦ something certain, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite certain; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the account kept the names of the certain ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996, without complaint, she wrote of another certain look in his eye in the same account, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more certain than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most certain reason for leaving in the whole shop, she said in 1998, was the one she could never quite name; the certain ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 确定（前置定语 a certain look in his eye：1986 年掌柜在账本里记下的那件确定的神色）
B. adj. 确定／某个（比较级 more certain than：文中两处，一处比他眼里的神色，一处比预想）
C. adj. 确定／某个（最高级 the most certain：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 确定（表语 too certain to do：母亲觉得它太确定，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 某个（前置定语 a certain reason for leaving：叔叔把整件事称作一桩某个的缘由）
F. adj. 某个（同级比较 as certain as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩离去的缘由相比）
G. adj. 某个（后置定语 something certain：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 某个（受程度副词修饰 quite certain：那位买主的评价）

items.q: a certain look in his eye
the most certain look in his eye anybody
The most certain reason for leaving in

answers.why: certain 意为“确定”，1986 年掌柜在账本里记下的是“一件确定的神色”，此处作前置定语 a certain look in his eye。
certain 意为“确定”，此处用比较级 more certain than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
certain 意为“确定”，账本上 七月 那行字说它是铺子里最确定的一件，故用最高级 the most certain look in his eye。
certain 意为“确定”，母亲认为这件东西“太确定了，谁也用不上”，too certain to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
certain 意为“某个”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩某个的缘由”，此处作前置定语 a certain reason for leaving。
certain 意为“某个”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩离去的缘由一样某个”，同级比较用 as certain as。
certain 意为“某个”，账本上那半行字要的是“某个的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something certain。
certain 意为“某个”，邻铺子来的那位买主认为这套计划“相当某个”，quite 修饰原级 certain。
certain 意为“某个”，1996 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要某个”，故用比较级 more certain than。
certain 意为“某个”，母亲 1998 年说的是“整个铺子里最某个的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most certain reason for leaving。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，掌柜在账本里记下了一件确定的神色。（a certain look in his eye）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更确定。（more certain than …）
母亲觉得它太确定，谁也用不上。（too certain to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩某个的缘由。（a certain reason for leaving）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩离去的缘由一样某个。（as certain as …）
到了 1993 年，账本上只剩半行字：要的是一件某个的东西。（something certain）
answers: In 1986 the shopkeeper wrote of a certain look in his eye in the account.
Everybody said it was more certain than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too certain to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a certain reason for leaving.
He said nobody would call it as certain as the reason for leaving they had once had.
By 1993 the account asked for nothing but something certain.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 certain 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the shopkeeper wrote of a certain look in his eye in the account, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most certain look in his eye in the shop, or so the account says.
My mother thought it too certain to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a certain reason for leaving, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next shop called the plan quite certain, and everybody laughed.
The certain ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
